exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Verb ておく (do something in advance)".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! 動詞ておく matches "Verb ておく (do something in advance)".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is 動詞ておく.
exercises.explanation: Expresses doing something in advance or as preparation for a future need.
